name: Dubh Lochan Flow
blurb: A drained corner of the Flow Country: rows of spruce on dried peat, ditches cut in straight lines, and a Vane Forestry sign. The bog is waiting under it, and it has all the time in the world.

lines: Rows of spruce on dry peat, and the ditches still draining the hill.
Drains blocked with peat dams, the first pools filling behind them.
Sphagnum spreading in the wet, cotton grass in the open ground.
Wet, red and gold with moss, and the plover back on the tops.

ranger: Spruce on dry peat, and the ditches draining the hill. Forestry did this in the eighties.
The drains are blocked with peat dams and the first pools are filling behind them.
Sphagnum's spreading in the wet, cotton grass in the open ground. Tread softly.
Wet, red and gold with moss. The flow's alive again, and so are the birds on it.
